Cooperation with the Ombudsman, municipalities, and also kindergartens and schools will strengthen the capacities at the individual and institutional level, through the inclusion of children in the decision-making process itself. SCAN: Census the Macedonian way, between statistics and politics — The population and household census, instead of being a statistical operation, is politicized and misused for political purposes and deterioration of inter-ethnic relations. In this edition of the political video magazine - SKEN, the most important events and attitudes related to the topic: Census 2021, i.e. the real need and method of conducting the census, as opposed to manipulations and political abuses, have been moved. The Assembly, with 62 votes "for", no "against" and "abstentions", adopted the Law on Census of Population and Households on January 21, according to which the census will be held in April this year. The hearing ended on January 15, when there was no quorum for voting. The deputies of VMRO-DPMNE were not in the hall for the voting and are currently collecting signatures from the citizens for the annulment of this law. The census law will be implemented from April 1 to 21, it will be carried out in the language chosen by the person taking the census or the person providing the data. Also, the law provides for a fine in the amount of 200 to 300 euros in Denar equivalent value for an offense against a natural person if he refuses to provide the data required of him for the Census or if he provides incorrect data. In order to maintain dignity - Left with a new draft law on days of mourning — Press conference of the MP from the Left, Amar Mecinović, on the occasion of the new proposal of the parliamentary group of the Left to eradicate inappropriate and unethical behavior during days of mourning: "The initiative stems from the need for a dignified, correct and fair arrangement of this sensitive matter. We believe that every society should set a framework for how to behave in moments of collective tragedy and pain. In the current legal framework, there is a serious legal vacuum when it comes to the arrangement of the days of mourning. Although the Government has the authority to declare days of mourning, as the Law on the flag provides for it to be put at half-mast - there are no clear rules or sanctions for disrespecting this act. We often see abuse of the tragedy through sensational media appearances, and the politicization of the days of mourning in Kočani, in which 60 of our citizens lost their lives - is a painful reminder of how important this matter is and that it is necessary to regulate it by law. With this draft law, we ask for the establishment of a clear, fair and dignified system for celebrating days of mourning in order to show respect, solidarity and build a culture of collective empathy in the country. This law offers the following: definition and criteria for declaring days of mourning on the basis of the scope and seriousness of the tragic event, which authority carries out the decision, in which period and in what manner; obligations for the setting of flags at half mast, the postponement of the manifestations that are not appropriate for the situation. This is in order to prevent insults, inappropriate use of the public space and political profiteering expression and private behavior, but it refers to the state, institutional, public work in those domains. This is also an invitation for all political parties and social actors to get involved and give an opinion on this sensitive matter for which we think we will find broad support in the Parliament. Among other things, this decision of ours comes on the basis of communication with media workers and with workers in the institutions dignity."

Derala: We have to work a lot on how the term multiculturalism is understood — The president of CIVIL, Jabir Derala, at the meeting with the mayor of the Municipality of Kumanovo, Maksim Dimitrievski, as part of the project "Together for a better future", which CIVIL is implementing with the support of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and European Affairs of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, emphasized that the topic of multiculturalism should be active because it constantly faces a series of challenges, and therefore, he adds, "a person should be wise, determined and courageous to deal with those challenges who will bring solutions that will give prosperity, stability and well-being to the citizen". "We have agreed with Mayor Dimitrov at the beginning of the next school year, which will start in September, to hold an art competition for children from elementary schools in Kumanovo who will draw on topics related to multiculturalism. We will participate as an organization, but we will also call on the business community to participate so that we can provide a decent prize fund for the children who will be winners and winners of that competition," Derala said. He added that we have to work a lot on how the term multiculturalism is understood, but also how the activities related to all those delicate areas that are part of this great world topic are carried out. "CIVIL as an organization not only promotes positive messages, it also keeps a watchful eye on all the tendencies that go against the Macedonian national interests, and it is a multicultural society that is Euro-Atlantic oriented, and we follow all those tendencies that come from inside and outside and try to threaten the Macedonian national interests. We want to point out to all decision-makers at the national and local level that multiculturalism, good inter-ethnic relations are a guarantee for prosperity, for the economic progress of our country, but they are also a guarantee for the stability and security of the country", emphasized Derala. text, camera and photo: Dehran Muratov editing: Arian Mehmeti multicultural Together for a Better Future
